question: Show the names of all singers who performed in more than three separate concerts held during the summer festival season
query: SELECT T2.name FROM performance AS T1 JOIN singer AS T2 ON T1.singer_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.id HAVING COUNT(T1.concert_id) > 3

Which countries share a land border with more than five other distinct sovereign nations across the same continent
query: SELECT name FROM country GROUP BY id HAVING COUNT(bordering_country_id) > 5

question: List all distinct official languages
query: SELECT DISTINCT language FROM country_language WHERE is_official = 'T'
